source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.2「目視外飛行」(2)②補助者を配置しない場合

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 補助者なしBVLOSでは飛行経路全体の航空機状況を常時確認できる監視手段が必要となる。
evidence.tested_misconception: 機体telemetryがあれば外部航空機の全経路監視は不要である。
evidence.reasoning_path: no-assistant BVLOS -> external aircraft risk -> full-route continuous monitoring

collision.note: LOW。B2 C025は機体状態/気象/経路偏差、Q064は機体速度把握であり、full-route aircraft surveillanceは未出。

independent_review.rationale: 4.2 no-assistant BVLOS requires continuous monitoring of aircraft along the entire route; distinct from existing ownship state/route-deviation monitoring.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
